original_failure.context: Pi client exited; an immediate agent_cancel landed while the turn was starting

root_cause.condition: turn/start returns a turn id before thread_state.active_turn_id is set; a non-empty turnId is rejected with invalid_request ('no active turn to interrupt' or 'expected active turn id ... but found ...')
root_cause.provider_documented_startup_path: turnId="" is treated as a startup interrupt, submits Op::Interrupt, and is acknowledged immediately

fix.behavior: interrupt waits for the real turn/started event (bounded), uses the real turn id once started, returns without RPC if the turn is already terminal, returns ProcessExited if the app-server exits, and otherwise uses the provider's startup interrupt (turnId="") after the bounded wait

verification.unit_tests: 5 interrupt tests + shutdown startup test passed; red before fix for never-started, terminal, and shutdown-startup cases
verification.service_immediate_cancel: cancel-start.json (3/3 queued -> cancelled, no cancel error)
